trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied checkpoint file path (--pretrain_path / --resume_path) is unpickled with full torch.load (arbitrary objects) or restricted to tensors/primitive containers; decided at each torch.load call site, with no shared loader.

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names generate_model; its only deserialisation is torch.load(opt.pretrain_path).

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI: python train.py --pretrain_path <file> (train.py:118 calls generate_model); test.py skips it because phase='test' (test.py:79, model.py:86)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names generate_model/pretrain_path only; resume checkpoints are the project's own torch.save output (train.py:86-91), so a solver could argue --resume_path loads 'trusted, self-produced' files and is a separate feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Resume must still restore optimizer state and integer epoch/batch_id fields saved by torch.save (train.py:86-91, 136-137); pretrain must still load the 'state_dict' key and partially merge it (model.py:89-92). An over-broad fix that rejects non-tensor entries or only allows model weights would break optimizer resume.

O6_input_shapes: checkpoint file path from --pretrain_path only (fix.diff:33-38); no other shapes

O7_producer.where: train.py:86-91 (torch.save of checkpoint dict consumed by train.py:135 and test.py:82)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: train.py --resume_path: full torch.load of checkpoint, untouched by the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: resume file is the project's own saved checkpoint, not a downloaded pretrained model
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (train.py) from landing point model.py, same top-level package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: test.py --resume_path: full torch.load before generate_model, untouched by the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: evaluation script, separate from generate_model named in the advisory

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a shared load_checkpoint helper that unpickles (torch.load / pickle.load) used by train/test
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: utils already holds file-loading helpers (load_lines used at test.py:12); factoring checkpoint loading there is a natural refactor

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a cached preprocessed-volume path loaded via np.load(allow_pickle=True) or pickle
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: 3D NIfTI loading is slow; caching preprocessed arrays next to the dataset is a common maintainer addition

O9_family: CWE-502 deserialization of untrusted data (pickle via torch.load)

O10_build.toolchain: pip; requirements pin torch==0.4.1, numpy 1.15.4, nibabel 2.4.1, scipy 1.1.0 (requirements.txt:4-7); torch 0.4.1 has no weights_only, so a modern torch would be needed for the fix
O10_build.project_tests: None for this area; test_ci.py only prints (test_ci.py:1-2); train.py --ci_test runs CPU toy training with pretrain_path cleared (train.py:101-112)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add weights_only=True to model.py:88 only, leaving train.py:135 and test.py:82 resume loads open.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix reassigns module __name__ to 'models.resnet' and passes a list of strings to torch.serialization.safe_globals (fix.diff:15-16,33), which is not a valid allowlist entry; the fix's quality is questionable.
train.py:139 reads checkpoint['epoch'] but train.py:87 saves 'ecpoch' (functional bug).
unverified: Repo size in MB not measured; only ~9 small .py files plus toy NIfTI data and images, so judged tiny.
